Notice Of Motion To Compel 1) The Depositions Of Persons Most Qualified From The City And County Of Sna Francisco To Testify As To Specified Matters; And 2) The Production Of Documents
Off Calendar Jun-03-2008 Text Ruling
MINI MINUTES: NO APPEARANCE BY EITHER PARTY. TENTATIVE RULING ADOPTED. Plaintiff Norma Marquez's Motion To Compel The Deposition Of Persons Most Qualified From The City And County Of San Francisco To Testify As To Specified Matter; And The Production Of Documents is granted. The argument that there is noone knowledgeable because certain activities are not handled by the City or are contracted out by the City has no merit. In fact someone must be knowledgeable that these are not the City's responsibility. If that is the City's knowledge, there is no reason for not producing a person with that knowledge who can speak for the City. The City's knowledge as to curb painting is also a proper subject for deposition, even if the knowledge does not exist.
The court does not find any merit to arguments regarding the relevance of the subjects of the Notice Of Deposition. The proper application of law relating to knowledge of the defect will not be determined by this motion.
Plaintiff's request for sanctions is denied. COMMISSIONER EVERETT A. HEWLETT, JR. MATTER NOT REPORTED
